$comment: Use "" for unavailable strings, null for unavailable numeric/measurement values, and [] for collections with no extracted entries. Missing information does not imply an explicit absence or zero. Use a strict JSON parser that rejects NaN and Infinity.

preparation.description: Reported manufacturing, thermal treatment, mechanical processing, and specimen surface preparation applicable to the tested material. Preserve ordering and conditions in prose. Use an empty string if unavailable; retain explicit statements such as 'No heat treatment was applied'.
preparation.title: Preparation

composition.description: Reported composition of the tested alloy. Include explicitly reported elements only. Use [] if no composition is extracted; this does not imply a pure material.
composition.title: Composition

microstructure.description: Reported microstructure in the tested condition, including phases, grain size, precipitates, and inclusions when stated. Do not substitute general explanations or post-corrosion morphology. Use an empty string if unavailable.
microstructure.title: Microstructure

material_class.description: Citrine-style category under the project's classification rules. Use an empty string if unresolved. Other is a positive classification, not a missing-value marker.
material_class.title: Material Class

element_symbol.description: Reported chemical element symbol, e.g. Fe, Cr, or Ni.
element_symbol.title: Element Symbol

amount.description: Reported amount with its original basis, e.g. wt% or at%. Use 'balance' only when explicitly reported. Use null if unavailable; do not substitute zero.
amount.title: Amount

test_temperature.description: Reported electrolyte temperature during testing; null if unavailable. Do not substitute preparation temperature or assume a number for 'room temperature'. Retain unresolved wording in procedure_description.

pitting_potential.description: Reported pitting potential in original units including the reported reference electrode. Use null if no numerical result can be represented. Do not substitute corrosion potential, repassivation potential, or non-pitting breakdown. Preserve unsupported inequality/statistical distinctions in result_note.

result_note.description: Brief clarification, e.g. no pitting observed, a strict inequality, experimental limit, statistical meaning, or conflicting values. Use an empty string if unnecessary.
result_note.title: Result Note

failure_notes.description: Extraction failures that make this row unreliable or incomplete, e.g. a pitting potential cannot be linked to its alloy, an ambiguous condition assignment, or an unreadable reported value. Identify the affected field and unresolved problem. Use an empty string normally. Ordinary unreported information is not a failure; scientific qualifications belong in result_note.
failure_notes.title: Failure Notes

Measurement.description: Reported value or bounds, optionally with units and symmetric uncertainty.

value.description: Single or central reported value; null or omitted if unavailable.
value.title: Value

min.description: Reported lower endpoint or lower bound; null or omitted if unavailable.
min.title: Min

max.description: Reported upper endpoint or upper bound; null or omitted if unavailable.
max.title: Max

unit.description: Original reported unit, e.g. wt%, at%, mol/L, or degC. Include the reported electrode reference for potentials, e.g. 'mV (SCE)' or 'V (Ag/AgCl, saturated KCl)'. Use an empty string or omit for dimensionless quantities or unavailable units. Do not infer units or electrode details.
unit.title: Unit

plus_minus.description: Magnitude of reported symmetric uncertainty, in the same unit as value. Requires a numerical value. Do not infer from minima and maxima. Null or omitted if unavailable.
plus_minus.title: Plus Minus

Measurement.title: Measurement

solute.description: Reported solute name or formula, e.g. NaCl or H2SO4.
solute.title: Solute

amount.description: Reported solute amount or concentration with original units. Preserve distinctions such as mol/L, mol/kg, wt%, and volume percent. Use null if unavailable.

test_types.description: Applicable method labels, e.g. potentiodynamic polarization, potentiostatic polarization, or cyclic polarization. Several may apply. Use [] if unavailable; describe their order in procedure_description.
test_types.title: Test Types

procedure_description.description: Reported testing sequence and conditions relevant to this outcome, including pretreatment, stabilization, potential ranges, changing scan rates, holds, and reversals. Use an empty string if unavailable.
procedure_description.title: Procedure Description

scan_rate.description: One reported scan rate adequately describing the scan relevant to this result. For multiple rates across protocol segments, use null and describe the schedule in procedure_description. 'Steady state' is not a numerical scan rate.

potential_step.description: Reported potential increment for stepped testing, e.g. 20 mV; not a scan rate. Use null if unavailable, inapplicable, or not adequately represented by one value.

step_hold_duration.description: Reported duration of each potential step. Use null if unavailable or inapplicable. Describe varying schedules in procedure_description rather than forcing one duration.

pitting_criterion.description: Reported criterion for identifying pitting, e.g. a current-density threshold, sustained current increase, or visual confirmation. Use an empty string if unavailable.
pitting_criterion.title: Pitting Criterion

preparation.description: Reported solution preparation and conditioning, including mixing, gas identity, deaeration/aeration duration, pH adjustment, and whether gas flow continued during testing. Deaeration is not itself a solute. Use an empty string if unavailable.
preparation.title: Preparation

solvent.description: Reported solvent or solvent mixture. Use an empty string if unavailable; do not assume water.
solvent.title: Solvent

composition.description: Reported solutes and their amounts. Use [] if unavailable; this does not establish that no solutes were present.
composition.title: Composition

ph.description: Reported pH as a number or a measurement object for a range or uncertainty. Use null if unavailable. Do not calculate missing pH or restrict it to 0-14.
ph.title: Ph

chloride_concentration.description: Explicitly reported chloride-ion concentration, including values calculated and then reported by the authors. Use null if unavailable. Do not calculate from salt composition during extraction or substitute typical seawater values.

description: Experiments extracted from one paper, retaining reported values and original units.

experiments.description: One record per reported pitting outcome. Includes material, electrolyte, test conditions, and reported pitting potential. Some information may be duplicated - for example, if multiple experiments are conducted on the same material, or use the same electrolyte. Use [] if no relevant experiments are identified.
experiments.title: Experiments

title: Citrine-style full-paper extraction
